rv.q: That’s where we find him as the lights rise again on “A Bronx Tale,” which retains sufficient heart, spice and humor nearly 20 years after its debut.
The Broadway-ish production values didn't make up for it seeming a bit worn and unnecessary —especially since the excellent film was still available (and is to this day).
What might have been a gut-punch melodrama ends up a half-hearted musical bildungsroman -- one that, for all its infusions of local color -- is surprisingly antiseptic.
'A Bronx Tale' provides a fun night in the theater.

cn.t: Critics find this nostalgic musical adaptation charming and entertaining, with energetic choreography and strong performances, though it breaks little new ground. An old-fashioned crowd-pleaser that delivers a fun theatrical ride.
